values.note: Park's 2027 rate sheet, Sun-Thu / Fri-Sat: on-season (April-October) basic $12 / $15, electric 30A $25 / $27, family electric 30A $36 / $42, platform tent $19 / $21; off-season (November-March) basic $10 / $12, electric 30A $21 / $23, family electric $32 / $34, platform tent $12 / $15. Rates include sales tax. A non-camper may charge an electric vehicle at a vacant electric site for up to an hour for $5.

fees.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/01/washington-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('ON-SEASON (April through October)', 'OFF-SEASON (November through March)', 'Sun.-Thurs. values.note: $2 a night off year-round for seniors 65+, persons with disabilities, military and veterans; ask at payment, with proof.

values.note: 48 campsites on the booking grid: 21 electric 30A (45-99 ft), 1 family electric, 24 basic (37-57 ft, one 23 ft) and 2 platform tent sites; 13 pull-throughs. Campground hosts occupy site 1 in season.

values.note: Water, modern restrooms and showers April-October only; off-season there is no water in the campground (frost-free hydrant on Highway 104 west of the park office). Park store open in season.

note: A single wooded campground near De Soto: an electric loop by the showerhouse and a long spur of basic sites. The Big River is about 600 m away through woods. Platform tents are set up April-October only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $10-15 basic base (weekday/weekend, 2027), electric +12, year-round, showers/laundry/dump; added 30A electric, military $2, flush/vault/water/store, 48 sites (was 38) to 99 ft with 13 pull-throughs, 12-month window, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30, reservations year-round. Not waterfront confirmed (~600 m to Big River). Pin OK.
